label: sec:crystal-resonance-intro
html: In bulk amorphous matter, thermal disorder averages out local fluctuations in the Reeb phase shift. In an ultra-pure single crystal, however, the periodic Bravais lattice enforces constructive Bragg interference of the q-Reeb phase across 10^{23} unit cells. This section designs a continuous-wave crystal-resonance experiment, derives the q-dependent Bragg peak splitting and magnetic friction signature, and establishes the projected sensitivity bounds for detecting substrate q-anisotropy in the laboratory.
